translation: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power
And what will explain to thee what the night of power is

arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
translation: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
translation: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand
Peace!... This until the rise of morn
